natural_input.description: Dataflow for a credit-controlled pipeline; only Producer, Pack, FIFO, Unpack, Consumer. Payload flows Producer -> Pack -> FIFO -> Unpack -> Consumer. Separate control credit flows Consumer -> Unpack -> FIFO -> Pack -> Producer. FIFO capacity is 3 entries, not a latency. No cycles or stage latencies are supplied.
